name: Mugibata Akane
source:
1st year Business Administrations student.
A bright and optimistic normal girl.
In order to succeed the family restaurant she enrolls at the university.
Because she was raised in the countryside she's very carefree.
Her specialty is making bread, pasta, and sweets.
